360 One Special Opportunities Fund – Series 8
(A Category II AIF Scheme)
NOTES:
1. TDS for Resident Investors:
Since CAT II AIFs have received Pass Through Status w.e.f. 1st April 2015, TDS @ 10% is deducted u/s 393(1) of the Act by the Fund in the PAN of resident
investors on gross taxable income earned/accrued by the Fund. In case of a Resident Investor valid PAN will be mandatorily required. However, if the PAN is
not updated or is invalid or is deleted, then the higher rate as per the Act u/s 397(2) (i.e., 20%) would apply.
2. TDS for Non-Resident Investors:
Since CAT II AIFs have received Pass Through Status w.e.f. 1st April 2015, as per section 393(1) of the Act, in case any income (other than business income) is
payable to a non-resident, tax is required to be deducted at 'rates in force'. Thus, the tax has been deducted at source as per the rates prescribed under the
Act or as per the applicable tax treaty, whichever is beneficial. where a valid TRC is provided and the DTAA benefit is available. In the absence of DTAA benefit,
and/or TRC is not available. Tax has been deducted at source as per the rates prescribed under the Act.
3. For folios under pledge, the distribution proceeds will be credited to the lender's Bank account as provided in the pledge letter.
4. The above statement has been prepared on the basis of investments made by the Fund as of 14 th May 2026.
5. The Fund has assumed complete payment of called drawdown by all investors in the fund for tax computation. The above statement is based on the details
available as of 14 th May 2026 .
6. As per section 115UB read with section 10(23FBA) of the Income-tax Act ('the Act'), the income of an AIF scheme, except for any business or profession income,
would be exempt from tax at the level of the AIF. In such a case, the income accruing or arising to or received by the investors out of the investment made in
the AIF scheme shall be liable to tax in the hands of the investors in the same manner as if the investments had been made directly by the investors.
7. Expenses include Management fees, Admin fees, STT, and Other Expenses. Other Expenses are inclusive of Legal and Professional Expense and any other
expenses which are not part of Admin fees. TDS liability on the same has been discharged by the Fund.
8. Interest income represents income from fixed deposits with banks, interest from Corporate Bonds/Index Linked Debentures, and interest earned on delayed
drawdown received from the investors.
9. The TDS amount reflected in Part II above is the estimated TDS liability, and the actual TDS on income generated during F.Y 26-27 will be deducted on actual
distribution of income or on 31st March 2027, whichever is earlier.
10. As per the amendment brought by the Finance (No 2) Act 2019 to the section 115UB of the Act, with effect from FY 2019-20 and onwards, in case net position
of income of the CAT II AIF is a loss, other than business loss (i.e., short term capital loss I long term capital loss), such loss would be passed on to the unit
holders in the CAT II AIF. The unit holders will be eligible to set off this loss against capital gains earned from the AIF or from any other source, in accordance
with the set-off provisions of the Act. However, the loss with respect to units that are held for less than 12 months should be ignored for pass-through purposes.
11. As per the recent amendment in the Finance (No.2) Act, 2024, capital gains on the transfer of unlisted bonds and debentures shall be considered as deemed
short-term capital gains.
12. Debt/Liquid Mutual Funds acquired post 1st April 2023 shall be considered as deemed Short Term.
13. Each Unit holder should consult their own tax advisor to evaluate the Income-Tax implications on income accrued from investments made by the Fund.
14. The investor agrees that the contents of this letter will be deemed to be accepted by the investor, unless, within 15 days of the date of this letter, the investor
informs 360 ONE Alternates Asset Management Limited of any discrepancies, and these discrepancies are found to be true. The trustee and the investment
manager retain the right to correct discrepancies, if any, found in the contents of this letter at a later date.
This is a system-generated statement and does not require a signature.
